data.description: 【夕 · 檐下听雨】烟雨蒙蒙的江南庭院回廊下，夕单手支颐倚靠在朱红雕花廊柱旁，静静注视着漫天细雨打在肥绿的芭蕉叶上，神情淡漠超然——「雨声最适合用来睡觉和发呆了……过来坐在我身边，借你的肩膀靠一会儿，不准推开我。」
data.promptProse: Under the covered Jiangnan veranda, Dusk leans against the carved vermilion pillar with one hand supporting her cheek, quietly watching rain strike broad banana leaves. Her ink-black qipao and gradient wide-sleeved robe remain beneath loose dark hair. The medium view places the pillar beside her and wet courtyard paving beyond. Grey rain light softly reveals her face and robe folds, reflecting from leaf surfaces while the veranda roof keeps the nearer timber shaded.
data.title: 夕 · 檐下听雨
